    Is Publix open on Easter Sunday in Florida?
    No. Publix locations in Florida and other states will not be open on Easter Sunday, which is Sunday, April 5. Of all the holidays throughout the year, Publix stores are closed only three days: Thanksgiving, Christmas, and Easter.19 hours ago

    Is Publix going to be closed on Easter?
    Which holidays are Publix stores closed? Publix stores are closed three days a year: Thanksgiving, Christmas and Easter. We also close early on Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve and New Year's Day; the times are posted in our stores prior to the holidays.
